notes: Room twists (S1 #4). A Tower battle or challenge room after the first one may get one twist, never more. 'chance' is per eligible room, tuned so about 1 room in 4 of a whole run has a twist. 'banner' and 'sensei' lines are final text from the Content Writer (drafts/content/text/room-twists.json). No twist may hide a warning.

twists.name: Lantern Dark

twists.sensei: Even in the dark, the light shows the way.

twists.name: Slippery Floor

twists.sensei: Listen for the bells. You can do it!
